race.comment: STAR JE TAIME (11) was good when third to Tanabata at Kyneton, beaten just under a length on soft ground after being held up. To a mile should suit now given her breeding. Looks well placed in a race weakened by scratchings. AMBITION IN BLOOM (6) was slow away and still fourth on debut at Kilmore so that effort had merit. Has scope to improve and that could see her as a danger. KUHEYLAN (3) went much better at Moe last start, finishing third and beaten a length after settling back. Could be ready to put it together now. FLYING RICHES (1) will be fitter for recent racing so could be ready to show more.
